name: Iverron's Antidote
summary: In Shadowglen, Iverron's Antidote must be brewed before a scout's poison takes hold. Dirania Silvershine needs wild mushrooms, lilies, and spider ichor to make the remedy.

sections.title: A Race Against Venom
sections.body: Young Iverron was scouting the boughs of Shadowglen when Webwood spiders struck him with their poisonous fangs. Now collapsed and dying, he depends on Dirania Silvershine's herbal knowledge at Aldrassil. His venom spreads fast, so she must prepare a remedy before it takes hold.

sections.title: Reagents of Shadowglen
sections.body: Dirania balances Teldrassil's restorative plants against the spiders' venom. Hyacinth mushrooms, which thieving grell favor in the south, make an earthy base. Moonpetal lilies from tranquil forest pools bring purifying qualities. She also needs Webwood ichor from spiders near Shadowthread Cave, to tailor the cure to their poison.

faq.answer: Iverron is a young night elf scout in Shadowglen. He ventured too close to the hostile Webwood spiders, and their venom struck him down.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Iverron's Antidote?
faq.answer: Dirania Silvershine gives the task and brews the remedy. She is stationed outside the great boughs of Aldrassil in Shadowglen.

faq.q: Why does the antidote need spider ichor?
faq.answer: Traditional herbal remedies use some of a creature's own bodily fluids or venom to counter the toxins in its victim. So Webwood ichor lets Dirania tailor the cure to the spiders' poison.
Hyacinth mushrooms grow at the bases of large trees throughout Shadowglen. They can also be pried from the clutches of the grell who hoard them to the south.
Moonpetal lilies bloom along the edges of quiet freshwater pools on Aldrassil's northwestern side.

faq.q: Where are the Webwood spiders located?
faq.answer: Webwood spiders dwell in Shadowglen's northern woods, especially near the dark entrance to Shadowthread Cave.

angles.text: As a night elf, tending to fallen kin is a sacred duty in Shadowglen. Every defender is needed to protect the newly budding World Tree.
As a druid, making remedies from local plants and countering natural poisons reflects the balance you strive to keep in the wild.
As an herbalist, you can see how Teldrassil's wild plants hold medicinal power when handled with care. Moonpetal lilies and Hyacinth mushrooms are examples.
